For rule-based metrics, we select the Rouge-L (RL) metric, which calculates the ratio of the longest common subsequence between system outputs and ground truth answers relative to the length of reference texts. For LLM-based metrics, we employ Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct and Llama3.1-70B-Instruct to assess the consistency between generated responses and reference answers.
